messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered: HIGH - ap-northeast2 GPU pool saturated, autoscaler requests failing with QUOTA_EXCEEDED. Impact: request queue length increasing for inference-hosted. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-quota-hit

alice_nguyen: seeing large backlog on the inference dispatcher. many small requests piling up, latency spiking. autoscaler logs show repeated 403/QUOTA_EXCEEDED from GCP during node creation.

samir: can anyone confirm if this is region quota or project-level limit? i've seen per-project quota errors before where the cloud returns a soft deny for new GPU attachments.

mike_ops: confirmed project quota. GCP response: "quota exceeded for compute.googleapis.com/accelerator_types/nvidia-t4" on createInstance. autoscaler is backoff-retrying every 30s. backoff + quota = queue growth.

katie_sre: tagging this as P0 for customer-facing impact. a handful of high-rt customer tenants are seeing 5-10x latency. routing fallback to eu-west1 is partially engaged but some customers pinned to ap-northeast2.

alice_nguyen: here's current numbers: queue length ~ 420 requests, median latency 1.8s -> 12s, errors 2.1% (rate-limited). throughput down ~35%.

andrew_platform: autoscaler is respecting cloud errors; it treats quota errors as transient and keeps retrying with exponential backoff. we should accelerate alternate paths: 1) force warmpool in eu-west1, 2) switch pinned customers to model-x-small, 3) raise support case with GCP quota ops.

samir: i'm starting a quota increase request now. filing with priority: https://console.cloud.google.com/quotas?p=project-id&filters=accelerator (ticket 1742). wont be immediate.

mike_ops: mitigation idea — update autoscaler policy to treat QUOTA_EXCEEDED as terminal for current attempt and immediately try a different zone/region. but risk: more churn/cost.

katie_sre: probably safe short-term. make sure to enable canary routing before a mass re-route. want minimal customer impact.

alice_nguyen: @deploy-bot can we temporarily enable cross-region fallback for the affected route? current routing policy prevents cross-region for regulatory customers — need an exception list.

deploy-bot: Received request: enable fallback for routes [inference-api/*] except tenants {govbank,healthco}. Applying change in 30s.

julia_cs: heads-up: reached out to two customers in apac on impacted tenant list; they're seeing slow responses but not errors. happy to send status update if we have ETA.

andrew_platform: i'm going to create a targeted pool in ap-northeast2 using lower-GPU instances (v100 -> t4 swap) so we can at least accept queued work on less optimal hardware. creating nodes with different accelerator type avoids the specific quota. starting now: `gcloud compute instances create --accelerator type=nvidia-t4,count=1 --zone=ap-northeast2-a --project=project-id --image=inference-node-image-v2`

samir: note: some workloads require V100; those will still be queued. we should move non-V100 workloads to the t4 pool via priority tagging.

mike_ops: implemented tagging change in the dispatcher. non-critical workloads will drain to t4s. initial drain successful: ~120 tasks moved off the V100 queue.

alice_nguyen: visible improvement: queue down to 300, median latency 6.2s. still above SLO but moving.

katie_sre: escalate to GCP quota ops — mention customer impact and that we've partially mitigated with fallback pools. include logs of the 403s and approximate new capacity required.

samir: quota ticket updated with logs and impact. request: +20 T4 accelerators and +5 V100 for safety. assigned to GCP support case 1742-AP.

andrew_platform: after we stabilize, we need a postmortem action: modify autoscaler to detect repeated QUOTA_EXCEEDED and switch strategy: immediate region failover OR create smaller-instance warm pool. add alerting for quota saturation sooner.

alice_nguyen: agreed. also add a circuit-breaker in the dispatcher so when queue > 250 for >5m we automatically shift low-priority traffic to fallback models/regions.

mike_ops: temporary customer update draft: "We're experiencing elevated latencies for inference in ap-northeast2 due to cloud GPU quota limits; we've rerouted non-regulated traffic to alternate pools and are working with our cloud provider to increase quota. We'll post updates every 30 minutes." want me to send?

julia_cs: send it. include link to status page and note the regulated customers are unaffected by reroute.

deploy-bot: change applied: cross-region fallback enabled for non-regulated routes.

alice_nguyen: current snapshot (T+35m): queue 185, median latency 3.1s, errors 0.6%. new t4 pool handling ~220 concurrent connections. autoscaler still logging quota rejects but overall intake capacity improved.

katie_sre: putting this on-call handoff list for next shift. primary mitigations done but root cause (quota exhaustion + overly-conservative autoscaler backoff) needs engineering follow-up.

samir: handoff notes: ticket 1742 in progress, t4 fallback pool created, routing changes in place, monitored metrics dashboard link: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/ap-northeast2-gpu.

alice_nguyen: thanks team. I'll keep monitoring and will start the post-incident doc with timelines and suggested remediation.

incident-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-1147. Severity: HIGH -> will transition to Sev2 when queue < 100 and latency < 2s sustained for 30m."
